science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
text: [DUSK_CRAFT at The_Simulacrum] Kaio bounded into the expansive, cavernous interior of The Simulacrum, grinning as he mapped the glowing wind-streams caused by the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea. The strobing emerald projections bathed the soot-stained brass walls in dancing light, while the sharp smell of airborne copper mixed heavily with bruised moss. He let out a breathless, three-note whistle as the biting electric chill wrapped around him, his boots tapping enthusiastically on the smooth quartz floor. Desperately hoping to attract Ryn's attention before the resonance spike hit, he leapt to defend the delicate calibration module, using his brass sextant to conceal it from the strobing ambient light. Recognizing the data was ready, he slapped the charged copper calibration baton directly into Ryn's hands, launching into a breathless explanation of the eddy currents.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Deliver the stabilized baton data to Ryn before the shear wave scrambles it
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Survive the convergence of the twin suns' polarity inversion

active_location.macro_silhouette: The Simulacrum's cavernous interior was a chaotic masterpiece of soot-stained brass and smooth quartz. Sweeping, strobing projections danced across the walls, suspended precariously above delicate calculation arrays.
